column1: # Commits that must never reach a remote. <full-sha>\t<reason>.
# Enforced by hooks/pre-push, installed into .git/hooks by `just install`.
# The manifest and its enforcement ship together on purpose: a list whose
# only enforcement lives in one operator's untracked .git/hooks is not a
# guard, it is a note that reads like one.
# Quarantine is TEMPORARY, and each entry says how it ends. It is not a
# tombstone: a commit nothing references should be allowed to become
# unreachable and be collected, not preserved behind a permanent refusal.
# To clear a branch: rebase or cherry-pick ITS OWN commits onto a parent
# that excludes the quarantined one, then re-check with

column2: Pre-neutralisation fixtures commit (2026-07-30). Its seven captured TUI panes carried an operator account address, the organisation name derived from it, a subscription tier and a session path. Superseded on main by the amended, neutralised 3f61802 — but it stays reachable from every branch cut before the amendment, and an ordinary merge would carry it back into public history. Rebase such a branch onto the neutralised commit before harvesting it. ENDS WHEN: `git branch --contains` lists no branch destined for harvest; then delete this line and let git collect the object. Nothing references it — checked across the tree and the ledger on 2026-07-30 — so there is nothing to preserve it for.
